title: Composing commissioned songs and the new Arbors solo record
summary: During lockdown he composed songs on commission and will record a new solo piano album for Arbors Records, including some of them.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made

blocks.x: Rossano, it sounds like there’s a suite of original compositions waiting to come out from you. That’s what I think.
Actually I’ve been composing during these months.

So what happens, here is another story. So already three months ago I sent out a newsletter from my website saying that I was willing to do private concerts on Zoom, that I was even willing to write songs under commission. So if someone thought that they wanted a song written for themselves or for someone else, and I got three or four people answering to that, and they asked me, you know I would like to have one song composed for my daughter, one song composed for my husband, I would like one song composed for my friend. And so I started more and more to sit at the piano with a piece of manuscript paper and a pencil and music started to come out of my fingers first, and then I would write it down. As soon as I would get a good idea, and so now I have quite a few. So I am preparing now actually, actually I will go in the recording studio this coming Thursday and Friday to do a new piano solo record for Arbors Records.
And so I’m going to include a few of these new compositions in this record.

But I think it’s nice — the thing about composing is you come up with the song that you like and then you tell yourself I did this. You know? So I’ve got my own tunes that I can improvise on now. And so it’s nice to throw it out there and see what other people think about it, without much expectations, but something nice to do.
